description: Arc 17 §17.3.7 — read the dynamic-lexicon resolver's in-memory cache. Returns the cached lexicon entry for a specific NSID, or a paginated list of all entries when no `nsid` is supplied. Auth: AdminAll scope. Idempotent.

nsid.description: Optional. When supplied, return the single matching cache entry (or empty `entries` if not cached). When absent, return a paginated list.

limit.description: Max entries returned in list mode. Ignored when `nsid` is supplied.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (the last NSID from the previous page). Ignored when `nsid` is supplied.
Present when more entries remain after this page. Pass to the next request as `cursor`.

isStale.description: True when `now >= expiresAt`. The entry is still served until evicted or re-fetched; v0.5 does not background-refresh stale entries (§17.5.4 v0.6+ candidate).
